official.name: Hungarian
official.family: Uralic — NOT Slavic, the one major exception in the region

terrainDescription.zh: 大匈牙利平原（Puszta）為主，地形平坦
terrainDescription.en: Dominated by the Great Hungarian Plain (Puszta), largely flat

plate.color: white background, black text, standard EU blue band with "H" code

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Standard European wedge-shaped bollard, red rectangular reflector on front, white on back (shared with Croatia, Bulgaria, North Macedonia)

utilityPole.transformerMount: "Holey poles" — concrete poles with large holes running all the way down to ground level

historicalContext.zh: 馬扎爾人（Magyar）約西元九世紀遷入此地，語言系屬與周邊斯拉夫、羅曼語族國家皆不同，是很獨特的語言孤島。
historicalContext.en: The Magyar people settled here around the 9th century; the language family is unrelated to neighboring Slavic and Romance-speaking countries — a notable linguistic "island."
